naming: recovered/rehydrated snapshot of web URLs; byte identity with the images used by the NCR authors is NOT certified (no original content hashes exist)

exclusion_rules.binding: train: official NCR ID (+ caption equal after NFC/whitespace, or exact after documented cp1252/latin-1->utf-8 mojibake repair of the official CSV); 41 records whose official URL differs from the CC3M row URL with the same crc32 -> UNRESOLVED. dev: unique exact caption match in CC3M validation consistent with ID prefix/suffix; repeated captions -> UNRESOLVED
exclusion_rules.download: status must be ok (HTTP 200, decodable image <=50MB)
exclusion_rules.placeholder: byte sha256 shared by >=3 records with >=3 distinct URLs, or imgur 161x81 removed image
exclusion_rules.html: HTML/non-image 200 responses rejected at download time by image decoding (status not_image); the later HEAD pass is metadata only (18k shutterstock/picdn HEADs returned 403 text/html after the crawl, not used for exclusion)
exclusion_rules.cross_split: FIT records with image bytes identical to a kept DEV image are excluded from FIT
